public_gates: identify the limiting row and alpha boundary
classify whether the failure is terminal-margin cliff, action drift, or hidden-state sensitivity

forbidden_shortcuts: do not run PPO in M273
do not run a new actor update in M273
do not promote a new checkpoint
hypothesis: M272's safe alpha is limited by a terminal-margin cliff on M183/M170 row 16; future learning needs a window-aware terminal-margin or trajectory-retention guard rather than another snippet-only actor update.
success_criteria: audit M183/M170 row16 at alpha 0.01025 and 0.0105
quantify the action and margin movement that flips the row
decide whether the next repair should be terminal-margin retention, trajectory anchor, or a stricter interpolation trust region
produce a concrete M274 manifest recommendation

commands.name: m273_boundary_audit
commands.command: Audit M183/M170 row16 replay rows and design the next retention objective before any further learning step.

decision_rule: M273 should not promote or train. It should explain the row16 trust-region cliff and pre-register the next repair path before any actor update or PPO.
